origin.label: Origin
origin.hint: Quality substrate (ADR): Production is live traffic; Imported and Re-evaluation are isolated.

rejected.title: Unmet demand
rejected.hint: Contacts rejected at the door for lack of resources (outage outcome). The cause points to the action: pool reservation vs contracted capacity.
rejected.none: No rejected contacts in the period.

capacity.title: Concurrency vs capacity
capacity.noData: No occupancy data in the period.
capacity.hint: Per-pool values are physical allocation (provisioned: instances × max). The tenant ceiling is the contracted capacity (C).
capacity.admissionHint: Sessions debiting the AI licence vs C_ai. Series starts 2026-08-02: the previous one measured a mixed pot (AI + human) and is not a continuation.
capacity.bufferHint: Mute-queue sessions (exempt from C) vs buffer ceiling (queue_max_total).
capacity.seriesHint: Peak concurrency per bucket vs capacity ceiling. Per-pool ceiling = provisioned; total ceiling = configured (pricing) when available.

queue.title: Queue wait over time
queue.noData: No queue data in the period.
queue.hint: Wait = duration of the queue segment (attended queue). Abandon % over queued contacts.

sla.title: SLA attainment by pool
sla.noData: No SLA data in the period.

trend.title: Daily Trend
trend.noData: No data for the selected period.

pauses.title: Pause Detail
pauses.noData: No pauses for the selected period.

cross.quadrantHint: X = resolution, Y = evaluated quality, size = sessions, color = NPS (green ≥50, blue ≥0, red <0).
cross.quadrantEmpty: No agent with evaluated quality in the period.

deploy.count: {{n}} deploy(s) in the period — hover a triangle for details
deploy.legend: ● day with an evaluation (no point = no evaluation that day) · ▲ deploy (pool color)
deploy.epochLegend: ● official quality per version (solid) · ┄ provisional, still finalizing (dashed) · X-axis = versions, ordered by deploy date

criteria.multiFormHint: Per-dimension comparison only within the same form. Forms: {{forms}}

quality.crossFormGuard: Comparing across agents requires the same form
quality.crossFormGuardHint: These agents were evaluated under different forms ({{forms}}). Select agents from the same form — or a single agent to compare across forms.
quality.sameAgentForms: Averages from different forms/campaigns of the same agent ({{forms}}) — comparable as context, not as a single yardstick.

domain.human: Human agents only — AI rows are disabled in this lens.
domain.ai: AI pools only — pick pools (one curve each); human rows are disabled.

list.title: Pools & Agents
list.noData: No agents in scope for the period.
list.pinPoolAvg: Pin pool average on the chart

detail.soon: Full agent detail arrives in the next step.

chart.noData: No data for this lens in the period.
chart.pendingViz: This lens's chart arrives in the next step.
